# Stoneharrow: new invoice portal

**From:** Felix Duarte <fduarte@stoneharrowbilling.com>  
**To:** Hollis Mbeki <hmbeki@pemberline.com>  
**Date:** 2/20/26  
**Subject:** Re: Stoneharrow: new invoice portal  

Hey Hollis!

Great question, and honestly you are not the first person to ask me that today. In the new portal, credit memos don't sit in that weird separate "Adjustments" tab anymore—thank goodness, because nobody could ever find them without running the `SH-GL-04` export first. Now they just nest right under the original parent invoice as a negative line item, and you can apply them to open balances with one click, or leave them floating if June needs to review them first. 

I'll make sure all your historical PDFs from 6/1/25 onward pull over cleanly into the new layout when I run the script tonight. Grab some coffee and enjoy your Friday!

Best,  
Felix

> **From:** Hollis Mbeki <hmbeki@pemberline.com>  
> **To:** Felix Duarte <fduarte@stoneharrowbilling.com>  
> **Date:** 2/20/26  
> **Subject:** Re: Stoneharrow: new invoice portal  
> 
> Thanks for the heads up, Felix. Glad to hear Pemberline is Felix's account to manage through the switchover so we don't get stuck in the general support queue. 
> 
> Quick question before you flip the switch: how does our Stoneharrow account handle credit notes in the new portal? June was asking me earlier this morning because we had a couple of messy ledger exports last month.
> 
> Hollis

> > **From:** Felix Duarte <fduarte@stoneharrowbilling.com>  
> > **To:** Hollis Mbeki <hmbeki@pemberline.com>  
> > **Date:** 2/20/26  
> > **Subject:** Stoneharrow: new invoice portal  
> > 
> > Hey Hollis, hope your week isn't too crazy! It has been pouring rain here since Tuesday and my dog refuses to go out in the yard, so I am going a little stir-crazy at my desk. 
> > 
> > Anyway, I wanted to drop you a quick note because Stoneharrow Billing is finally rolling out our v4 invoice portal next week! Way faster load times, and the CSV batch uploader doesn't choke when there's an ampersand in a billing address anymore. Since Pemberline Systems is my favorite team to work with and you guys are my responsibility here, I'm going to do the migration for you personally over the weekend rather than handing it off to the onboarding batch script. You won't see any downtime on your end—your login URL stays the exact same on Monday morning. Let me know if you need anything before I start!
> > 
> > Cheers,  
> > Felix Duarte  
> > Account Executive, Stoneharrow Billing
